scope: Compiled copies of an employer report's record under another spelling at the same employer: same reporting label, pay and disclosed expenses, the report's only such record that year, and a compiled spelling the employer never printed. Every pair was read; held pairs are listed with why. No payment, period or expense is changed; all observations remain.
